# Where to Watch The Story of Angel


by Angel | September 1, 2026


You know Angel. But do you know the story behind it?


Long before Angel became a studio, its founders were a small team of entrepreneurs trying to build something new. Along the way came lawsuits, crowdfunding campaigns, unexpected breakthroughs, major risks, and more than a few moments when it looked like everything might fall apart.


*The Story of Angel* goes behind the scenes of that unlikely journey, from the company’s earliest days to the creation of the studio and Guild that exist today.


[Watch The Story of Angel now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/story-of-angel)


### **Before Angel, There Was a Skip Ad**


The story starts even earlier than most people realize.


Before they were making movies and series, Angel’s founders were changing the way people watched advertising online. The team behind Harmon Brothers pioneered the skip-ad format, creating a button that would become familiar to internet users everywhere.


That early success might seem like a completely different story from the one that eventually became Angel. But it was the beginning of a much bigger idea: What happens when a group of people decides there has to be a better way?


### **From VidAngel to Angel**


The road from a small startup called VidAngel to a full-fledged entertainment studio was anything but straightforward.


The company faced legal battles that threatened its future, forcing its founders and supporters to make difficult choices about what came next. When the traditional path seemed closed, the community rallied through crowdfunding, helping prove that there was an audience willing to support a different kind of entertainment company.


Then came *The Chosen* , theatrical releases, new original productions, and eventually the creation of the Angel Guild.


Each breakthrough came with its own challenges. And each challenge became part of the story.


### **The Risks Behind the Breakthroughs**


It’s easy to look at where Angel is today and forget how uncertain the journey once was.


*The Story of Angel* explores the failures, financial pressures, lawsuits, and setbacks that could have ended the company long before it became a studio. It also captures the moments when taking a risk paid off and when a community of viewers became something much bigger than an audience.


The result is a behind-the-scenes look at what it takes to build something when there’s no guarantee it will work.


### **More Than the Story of a Company**


At its core, *The Story of Angel* is about people trying to build something they believe in—and discovering just how much it can cost to keep going.


For longtime Angel viewers, the docuseries offers a look at the history behind the movies and shows they’ve watched. For newer viewers, it provides the backstory behind a studio that came from an unlikely place and took an unconventional path through the entertainment industry.


It’s also a reminder that success rarely looks inevitable while you’re living through the hardest parts.


### **Watch** ***The Story of Angel*** **on Angel**


Whether you’ve been part of the Angel community from the beginning or you’re just discovering it, *The Story of Angel* offers a chance to see what happened behind the scenes—the risks, the setbacks, the breakthroughs, and the people who kept going when quitting would have been easier.


The story behind Angel is anything but ordinary.
